title: Warm Mediterranean Caramelized Savoy Cabbage Skewers
description: A funky and kid-friendly Mediterranean dish featuring caramelized Savoy cabbage, perfect for a snack or light meal. This gluten-free-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection on a cedar plank.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the Savoy cabbage pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the cabbage pieces onto the soaked cedar planks, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the cabbage with the remaining marinade and drizzle with honey.
Place the cedar planks on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the cabbage is caramelized and slightly charred.
Flip the planks halfway through cooking to ensure even cooking.
Remove the planks from the grill and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
